editionLabel: GaGa Games · English summary of the Russian base-game manual · ©2026 · main competitive mode · 3–5 players
firstPlayerRule: The player whose titan has the highest speed takes the first main turn. Phase 1 then proceeds clockwise.
officialTieBreak: If the highest speeds tie, compare the tied players' second-fastest bench titans, then their next-fastest titans. If the tie remains, draw lots.
clarifications: The youngest player starts the setup draft, choosing one titan from three face-up cards; drafting proceeds clockwise until each player has three titans. For a first game, the manual instead says to deal three titan cards to each player.
After titan selection, players apply their titans' Start of Game abilities in turn, beginning with the player whose titan has the highest speed, before entering Phase 1.

Once two titans are on the arena, the faster arena titan's player acts first in enhancement and combat; if their speeds tie, the contender acts first. This is a separate order from the initial main turn.

After a duel, return to Phase 1 with the player to the left of the previous contender. If that player also fought in the previous duel, start with the player to their left; the remaining champion does not take part in this phase.
This English summary covers the main competitive opening in the reviewed Russian manual. The two-player, two-versus-two, solo/cooperative, challenge and expansion rules are separate scopes.
Follow a titan or enhancement card if its text overrides a general rule.

uncertainty: This is an English summary of the Russian GaGa manual; no original or English manual, latest revision, printed edition number, release day or universal edition equivalence was established.
Main 3-5 scope combines the publisher-linked product 1-5 range with the separately described solo/cooperative, duel and team modes. The manual does not provide a main-mode 3-5 heading.
The source says to draw lots for a remaining opening speed tie without prescribing a particular random device. No house fallback is supplied.
Individual titan/card rules can override the general manual. Unique effects and card timing exceptions are outside this opening summary.

Two-player mode gives five enhancement cards and four titans per player and forces Challenge. In two-versus-two, allies jointly choose the replacement titan after their titan loses. Solo/cooperative play starts with the opponent champion and humans agree who sends a titan. These modes are excluded from this record.
Optional betting is placed between Phase 1 and Phase 2 and reveals bets simultaneously; it does not establish the initial main starter. Pantheon and Mindbug expansions are not proposed for approval.
PDF metadata epoch CreationDate/ModDate are file facts only; printed Russian copyright 2026 is the edition label evidence. The product is still an expected November 2026 listing at retrieval.
